summary: Thiscall loop over a singly linked audio-node list. Starts at the head pointer stored at this+0xFC (this[63]); for each node, resolves the node's string name through StringLookupInLinkedDictionary and stores the result at node+0x10, then advances to the next node via the link pointer at node+0x14 until it is null. Called from AudioEngineInitialization during audio engine startup.

local_names.this: audio engine object whose node list head lives at this+0xFC
local_names.node: current linked-list node; +0x10 stores the resolved dictionary result and +0x14 is the next-node link

operations.description: Walk the singly linked list: begin at the head this+0xFC (this[63]), follow the next-node link at node+0x14 after each iteration, and terminate when the next link is null
If the head pointer at this+0xFC is null the loop body never executes and the function is a no-op
For each node, resolve its string name through StringLookupInLinkedDictionary
Store the dictionary lookup result into node+0x10 (the resolved-value slot of the audio node)
Invoked from AudioEngineInitialization (00546010) as part of audio engine startup
